path_to_entry.requirement: Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics with 60 percent aggregate and 50 percent in English. Medical standard is absolute: 6/6 vision without aids and no colour blindness.
IMU CET or a DG Shipping approved institute's admission, plus a company sponsorship test.

Either a one-year Diploma in Nautical Science or a three-year B.Sc Nautical Science, at a DG Shipping approved institute. Both lead to the same certificate and both cost like a degree - the DNS is a one-year course priced in lakhs.

entrance_exams.note: The examination is not the constraint. COMPANY SPONSORSHIP for the 18 months of shipboard training is, and a student can complete the diploma and still be unable to proceed.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

ai_exposure.reason: Very low exposure. Ships are increasingly automated and crewed by fewer people, but a certificated officer must be aboard and personally answerable for the safe navigation of the vessel under international convention. Autonomous shipping is real and slow, and the regulatory requirement for a licensed human on watch is what this profession rests on. Marine Surveyor Trainee and Port Operations Officer carry more exposure through documentation and inspection tooling.

nuances.statement: Tier A. The Second Mates (Foreign Going) Certificate of Competency is issued by the Directorate General of Shipping after its own examination, and serving as a deck officer without one is unlawful. This is the same statutory structure as the MEO certificates recorded for Marine Engineer in Sector 2.

The binding constraint is not academic. Eighteen months of shipboard training requires a shipping company to sponsor a cadet berth, and the number of berths is far smaller than the number of people completing pre-sea courses. Students routinely pay for a diploma and then cannot proceed. Any institute that does not guarantee sponsorship in writing should be treated with suspicion.

The cost of entry is the part students underestimate. A DG Shipping approved pre-sea course is priced in lakhs whether it is the one-year diploma or the three-year degree, it is paid up front, and it does not guarantee the cadet berth that the certificate depends on. Money spent before sponsorship is money at risk.

PCM is required and so is a MEDICAL standard that no other profession in this dataset imposes: uncorrected 6/6 vision and no colour blindness. That excludes a large number of academically eligible students, and it should be checked before any money is spent.

Set level with Marine Engineer in Sector 2 rather than above it. Deck and engine officers hold parallel Certificates of Competency on the same ship under the same international convention, and a gap between them was not defensible. The highest earnings in this sector by a wide margin, and they are earned at sea in tax-advantaged foreign-going service, away from home for months. Shore roles after sailing pay substantially less, which is the trade every officer eventually makes.

Built in Sector 16 and moved here on review. The substitution test decided it: remove travel and hospitality and a deck officer's work - navigation, watchkeeping, cargo, safety - survives completely unchanged, because a cargo ship carries no passengers to host. The setting was doing the work of a sector. It also ends a split that should never have existed: MARINE ENGINEER was already here, and the deck officer holds the parallel Certificate of Competency on the same ship. Two halves of one crew were in two different sectors.

admin_review.reason: The highest figure and the widest spread anywhere in Sectors 8 to 18 - 13 to 32 lakh - and entirely unsourced. A fetchable anchor exists and should be used: the NUSI-MUI and INSA collective bargaining wage scales publish monthly rates for a Third Officer on Indian-flag foreign-going ships, and ITF minimum scales cover the international floor. Sourcing it would make this the sector's one statutory-style anchor, as the Majithia award is for Sector 9.

professions.one_liner: Decides how a city or region grows - land use, zoning, transport, and what may be built.

deviating_roles.why: Transport and spatial analysis is modelling - travel demand, network capacity, population projection - done in software against datasets. It is the quantitative end and it transfers directly to GIS and data work outside planning.

Development control is applying a statutory master plan to a specific application, refusing some, and being argued with by developers and politicians. It is a municipal post with real authority and real pressure, and it is where most planning graduates actually work.
Urban design works at the scale of a street or a precinct - how a place feels to walk through. It sits between planning and architecture and is the most visual role here.

JEE Main Paper 2B (B.Planning), or a state or institutional entrance.
B.Plan (4 years), or B.Arch followed by an M.Plan - the postgraduate route is how many architects enter planning.
State Town & Country Planning department, a development authority, a municipal corporation, a Smart Cities or AMRUT programme unit, or a planning and infrastructure consultancy.

entrance_exams.note: JEE Main Paper 2B is the main national route and it requires only Mathematics in class 12, which is a materially different door from the B.Arch one.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Independent planning and development consultancy - master plan work, environmental and transport studies, and development applications for private clients. Realistic after eight to ten years and it depends on knowing how a specific authority works.

ai_exposure.reason: Moderately exposed on the analysis and protected on the decision. GIS Planning Analyst and Transport Planner work with spatial models and projections that are increasingly automated, and drafting a standard land-use report is generatable. What does not automate is Development Control Officer: refusing a builder's application under a statutory master plan, and defending that refusal, is authority exercised by a named person who can be sued and pressured.

nuances.statement: Mathematics ONLY, and this is the point of the record. JEE Main Paper 2B requires Maths in class 12 and does NOT require Physics or Chemistry, so a commerce student with Maths can enter the built environment through planning when B.Arch and B.Tech are closed to them. That door is barely known and it is why this profession was added.

Null, and it is the clearest contrast with Architect in this sector. The Architects Act 1972 protects the TITLE 'architect' and the Council of Architecture maintains a register; NOTHING equivalent exists for planners. The Institute of Town Planners India is a voluntary professional body, not a statutory regulator, which is why this record is Tier B and Architect is Tier A.

Kept separate from Architect rather than folded in as job roles, on the merge test in DECISIONS.md 8.95. The object of concern differs - a building against a settlement - and so does the skill set: zoning law, transport modelling, demographic projection and statutory development control have no counterpart in structural design. The entry gates differ too, which is decisive: PCM and a protected title for one, Mathematics alone and no register for the other.

Shortlisting is on GATE score alone, in a ratio of about one to seven, followed by interview, and the GATE paper must match the discipline of the post. Section 126 of the Patents Act 1970 sets four conditions: Indian citizenship, age at least 21, a science, pharmacy, engineering or technology degree from an Indian university, and passing the qualifying examination — or ten years of service as a patent examiner. path_to_entry.requirement: None for crew roles. Broadcast operations usually wants a diploma in electronics or media technology.
On-the-job. Most crew enter through someone they know on a unit; broadcast operations enters through an ITI or polytechnic diploma.
Day-rate crew on shoots and events, or a rostered post at a broadcaster or studio.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Owning equipment and hiring it out with yourself attached - lights, grip gear or a camera package. This is the standard way crew income rises in Indian film and events, and it is capital, not promotion.

ai_exposure.reason: Almost unexposed, and for the plainest reason in the model: this is physical work in an unstructured space. Nothing generative rigs a light, lays a dolly track or loads a van. Broadcast Master Control Operator is the one role with real exposure, because automated playout has already reduced how many people a transmission needs.

nuances.statement: The base layer of the film and television industry, and the pay reflects that: it fails the compensation filter. Work is per-day, seasonal and almost entirely informal, with no contract and no notice. The record shows this honestly rather than dressing up glamour-adjacent work as a career.

Moderate and concentrated geographically. Essentially all of this employment is in Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kochi and increasingly Noida - a student outside those cities cannot enter this profession without moving.

admin_review.reason: No sourced figure exists for Indian film crew day rates, which are the only number that matters in this profession, and none for what equipment ownership earns - the route by which crew income actually rises. Both are needed before this record can be trusted, and at 4.2 LPA employed it currently reads as a dead end.

professions.one_liner: Teaches a trade to people who will do it - ITI, apprenticeship and skilling programmes.

deviating_roles.why: Assessment under the National Skills Qualifications Framework is judging whether a candidate meets a written standard, on behalf of a Sector Skill Council. The assessor does not train the people they assess.
Employability training is communication, interviews and workplace behaviour rather than a trade. It is attached to skilling programmes and is a different job entirely.
Trade instruction is demonstration at a bench or a machine, taught by someone who did the job. It is the closest teaching gets to the trade itself.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream, or an ITI trade certificate.
Work in the trade. This is what actually qualifies a vocational trainer and no course substitutes for it.
Craft Instructor Training Scheme (CITS) for ITI posts, or a Sector Skill Council Train-the-Trainer certification for NSQF programmes.
Government or private ITI, a skilling partner under PMKVY, a corporate training centre, or an industry apprenticeship programme.

entrance_exams.note: CITS is the recognised public qualification for ITI instructors; Sector Skill Council certifications govern who may deliver and assess NSQF-aligned training.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Running a private training centre affiliated to a Sector Skill Council, or independent corporate and industrial training. Both depend on holding the certifications that let you certify others.

ai_exposure.reason: Low exposure, protected by the same thing the trades themselves are protected by: you cannot teach someone to weld through a screen. Placement & Employability Trainer and Assessor (NSQF) carry the exposure - communication training and standards-based assessment are both substantially generatable. ITI Instructor and Workshop Instructor are as safe as the trade they teach.

nuances.statement: Moderate and policy-driven rather than market-driven, which is a real risk worth naming. A large part of this profession is employed through government skilling schemes, so demand moves with scheme funding cycles rather than with the underlying need for trained workers.

Placed in Education rather than Sector 2 with the trades, on the teaching-anything rule. The counterpart decision is that a working electrician stays in Sector 2 - the same subject, split by whether you do the work or teach it.

professions.in_track_because: named inclusion — ITI instructor - one of the few stable government paths open to a DIPLOMA engineer, which no other record in the track offers.
